headwords: Nam mô A Di Đà Phật

flags.why: The term remains in ordinary use among overseas Vietnamese, so an unqualified dated tag is misleading ([usage example](https://www.voatiengviet.com/a/nghien-cuu-khoa-hoc-250-ty-my-kim/5923825.html)).
The example explains an old country name instead of using it to refer to the country.
flags.fix: Ông ấy từng sống ở Phi Luật Tân. = He once lived in the Philippines.
